title: Autotriage vector-quality shifts on config or model updates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Build an automated pipeline that detects, scores, and autotriages embedding and reranker quality regressions triggered specifically by configuration or model variant changes. The system should run fast offline evaluations and lightweight production-shadow probes on change events (model binary, quantization profile, kernel selection, batching policy, routing rules) and produce a clear pass/fail decision, prioritized investigation items, and suggested rollback or mitigations for canary/rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: On any model or config change event, the pipeline runs and outputs a deterministic regression report within 45 minutes for full offline suite and within 5 minutes for fast shadow probes
Regression report includes delta for MRR@10, Recall@k (1,5,10), Precision@k, nDCG@10 and similarity-distribution drift metrics with historical baseline window
Automated autotriage annotates likely root cause (quantization, kernel mismatch, input-distribution shift) with confidence score and links to top 3 example failures
If an SLO is breached (configurable per project), the system can flag and block canary progression in the Console rollout UI
Artifacts (evaluation traces, example queries, metric plots) are stored to S3 and linked in the generated ticket or PR
proposed_solution: Trigger: Git commit or config push that changes model hash or inference config will enqueue a change-eval job
Runner: Offline evaluation harness that replays a fixed set of benchmark queries and customer anonymized shadow samples. Compute primary metrics and distributional drift signals
Fast path: Lightweight shadow probes sampling production traffic for 5 minutes to catch large regressions before full offline completes

Autotriage: Heuristics + classifier that maps metric deltas and distribution signals to likely root causes (e.g., quantized precision loss, batching-induced tokenization mismatch, kernel fallback), outputting suggested mitigations
Gating: Integrate with Console rollout API to mark a canary/rollout as blocked if thresholds crossed; provide rollback suggestion and an autogenerated investigation ticket/PR template
Storage: Save evaluation artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/ENG-33011/<change-id>/ and attach signed URLs in reports
Notifications: Post summary to Slack ops-channel and create Linear investigation ticket when high-severity regression detected
tasks: Spike: catalogue existing offline eval suites and map required inputs (2d) - Maya
Implement change-event hook in model registry (3d) - Ravi
Build fast shadow probe runner and lightweight metrics (5d) - Eng-1
Extend offline harness to compute distributional drift signals and store artifacts (4d) - Eng-2
Autotriage prototype (heuristics + small classifier) and tie to example extractor (4d) - Eng-3
Console integration for gating and UI annotation (3d) - Frontend
Alerting playbook and PR/ticket template generation (2d) - SRE/Oncall
Run cross-team runbook review and tabletop exercise (2d) - PM/Support
risks: False positives from small-sample shadow probes could block harmless rollouts
Autotriage misattribution could mislead investigations; need human-in-the-loop review for P0s
Runtime overhead if full offline suite is run too often; must cap frequency and use sampling
Access to customer queries for shadowing requires privacy review and may limit coverage
S3 artifact retention and cost needs policy to avoid runaway storage
